purpose: Execute the atomic shell-body operation within the MA-11 boundary: One root-part native shell command. A nonempty valid remove_faces set binds to Shell.RemoveFaces; an empty set binds to Shell.ShellBodies. It does not select faces semantically, save, or infer a result from command return order.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires shell-body and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: A current closed nonempty root-part body.

inputs.name: remove_faces
inputs.description: Optional nonempty distinct face set owned by body. An empty set selects whole-body shelling. Default: [].

inputs.name: offset_mm
inputs.description: Signed shell thickness/direction in millimetres; converted to the V21 length unit before the command call.

preconditions: body is a current root DesignBody and passes the pre-operation closed positive-volume check.
remove_faces is empty or contains distinct current faces owned by body.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: {body: current root DesignBody, mode: remove-faces|whole-body, offset_mm: number, remove_face_count: integer, is_closed: boolean, volume_mm3: positive number}; a shell with removed faces may be open, so closure is reported rather than assumed.

postconditions: The selected V21 Shell command reports success.
After re-enumerating current root bodies, exactly one changed/surviving root body is identified with positive volume; result ordering is ignored.
The output records whether the resulting shell remains closed, because removing faces can intentionally create an open shell.

ambiguity_checks: Zero or multiple matches must stop the action; numbered aliases and return order are not valid identity criteria.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Root bodies are enumerated before and after the mutating command; all prior topology references are stale after success.

failure_modes.condition: Body is stale/noncurrent, faces are empty/duplicate/nonowned, or offset is non-finite or zero.
failure_modes.detection: Body is stale/noncurrent, faces are empty/duplicate/nonowned, or offset is non-finite or zero.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use until the declared recovery is completed from a clean state.

failure_modes.condition: Shell command reports failure, raises, or no unique positive-volume changed body is found.
failure_modes.detection: Shell command reports failure, raises, or no unique positive-volume changed body is found.
failure_modes.safe_state: Treat the document as potentially partially mutated; do not promote downstream references.

recovery.action: Re-enumerate the current body/faces and supply a finite feasible signed offset; no shell command is called when preconditions fail.
Treat the root document as potentially partially mutated, inspect/reopen a clean run-owned copy, and rerun only after thickness/removal feasibility is diagnosed; no rollback is implemented.
